cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is CES529, a flight from Wuhan to Shanghai, you are near departure time, one passenger was found taking some forbidden goods on board, you have to check his luggage again, contact Wuhan Delivery and request delay the flight.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是东方529，一架从武汉飞往上海的航班，你现在接近离场时间，一名乘客发现携带违禁物品登机，你需要再次检查他的行李，联系武汉放行，请求推迟航班。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES529, a passenger has taken some forbidden goods on board, we are checking the luggage again, request delay our flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方529，一名乘客发现携带违禁物品登机，我们需要再次检查他的行李，请求推迟航班。

cards.audioText:
C: CES529, roger, call me back when ready.
B: [Now you are ready to copy ATC clearance to Shanghai, you are at gate 212. You have received information J.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方529，收到，准备好时叫。
【你现在准备好抄收到上海的放行许可，你在212号机位。你已经收到通播J。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES529, gate 212, information J received, request ATC clearance to Shanghai.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方529，212号机位，收到通播J，请求飞往上海的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, clear to Shanghai via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF 02 departure, initial climb to 1800m, cruising level 10100m, Departure frequency 119.25, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方529，可以经由计划航路飞往上海，跑道36右，ZF02离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10100米，离场频率119.25，应答机2515。
cards.referenceText: Clear to Shanghai via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF 02 departure, initial climb to 1800m, cruising level 10100m, departure frequency 119.25, squawk 2515. CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往上海，跑道36右，ZF02离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10100米，离场频率119.25，应答机2515，东方529。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have completed push back and start up procedures. You are ready for taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已经完成推出开车程序，你准备好滑行了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES529, push back and start up completed, request taxi. （可以直接说request taxi）
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方529，已经推出开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, taxi to holding point runway 36R, via taxiway Z4, T3, C and A1.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方529，经由滑行道 Z4、T3、C和A1滑行至跑道36右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R, via taxiway Z4, T3, C and A1, CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道 Z4、T3、C和A1滑行至跑道36右外等待点，东方529。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are airborne, leaving 1200m for 2400m, make an initial contact with Wuhan Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已离地，从1200米飞往2400米，与武汉离场建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES529, airborne, leaving 1200m for 2400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方529，离地了，从1200米飞往2400米。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, Wuhan Departure, radar identified, turn right direct to ZF, climb to 5100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方529，武汉离场，雷达已识别，右转直飞ZF，上5100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to ZF, climb to 5100m, CES529.

cards.audioText: [Now you are over ZF, maintaining 5100m, squawk 2515, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你在ZF上空，5100米保持，应答机2515，与武汉区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES529, over ZF, maintaining 5100m, squawk 2515.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方529，过ZF，在5100米保持，应答机2515。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are cruising at 10700m. Your instruments indicate one of your air conditioning packs has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request to descend to a lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【目前你在10700米巡航，仪表显示一个空调组件失效，联系上海区调，请求下降到较低高度。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES529, maintain 10700m, request descent due one air conditioning pack has malfunctioned.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，东方529，10700米保持，由于一个空调组件失效，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, turn right heading 240, descend to 8900m initially.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方529，右转航向240，初始下降至8900米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 8900m initially, CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，初始下降至8900米，东方529。

cards.audioText:
C: CES529, What's the situation like on board now?
B: [Tell the controller that you have pressurization problem, cabin altitude is rising slowly and request descent to 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方529，机上现在情况如何？
【告知管制员，你出现增压问题，客舱高度缓慢上升，请求下降到3000米。】
cards.referenceText: Request descent to 3000m due cabin depressurization, CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于客舱失压，请求下降到3000米，东方529。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, descend to 3000m on QNH 1031.
B: [During emergency descent, the cabin crew reported five passengers in the cabin are seriously injured, inform the situation to Shanghai Control and request divert to Hangzhou.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在紧急下降过程中，乘务员报告客舱内5名乘客受伤严重，将情况告知上海区调，请求备降至杭州。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES529, 5 passengers were injured during emergency descent, request to divert to Hangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，东方529，在紧急下降过程中，有5名乘客受伤严重，请求备降至杭州。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100m, QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方529，右转航向180，下降至2100米保持，QNH1031。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100m, QNH 1031, CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，下降至2100米保持，QNH1031，东方529。
